name: print-social-hitech-minimal-tech-posts-purple-pink-circuit-line-icons
title: 'Hitech Minimal Tech' pack in deep purple with pink-cyan circuit-line icons and diagonal split covers
whatItIs: Five deep-purple square posts split diagonally with white corners, glowing pink-and-cyan circuit-line paths and node dots, small flat character illustrations of people with laptops, gear and settings line icons, and 'Hitech Minimal Tech' headlines.
whatItMeans: Sharp and techy; the glowing circuit paths turn a plain diagonal split into a distinctly electronic visual signature.
techniques: Split a square diagonally between white and a bold colour field.
Draw glowing circuit-line paths with dot nodes as a tech motif.
Use small flat character illustrations for a human touch.

vocabulary.definition: A decorative pattern resembling electronic pathways.
A layout divided by an angled line into two fields.
